name: Scout
description: Members of the exploratory service. Scouts survey uncharted worlds, map new routes, and make first contact with alien species.

assignments.name: Courier
assignments.description: You are responsible for shuttling messages and important packages from one world to another.

assignments.name: Survey
assignments.description: You survey uncharted worlds, creating star maps and gathering data.

assignments.name: Exploration
assignments.description: You go to the edge of known space and beyond, exploring new worlds.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: Your ship is ambushed by hostile forces.
events.effectDescription: Roll Pilot 8+ or Gunner 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Injury table.
Gain one of Animals (Riding or Training) 1, Survival 1, Recon 1 or Science 1.

effects.detail: Gain Animals 1, Survival 1, Recon 1 or Science 1

events.description: You perform an exemplary service for the scouts.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You spend several years jumping from world to world in your Scout ship.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Astrogation 1, Navigation 1, Pilot (Small Craft) 1 or Mechanic 1.

effects.detail: Gain Astrogation 1, Navigation 1, Pilot 1 or Mechanic 1

events.description: When dealing with an alien species, you have an opportunity to gather extra intelligence about them.
events.effectDescription: Roll Deception 8+ or Persuade 8+. Succeed: gain an Ally and an extra Benefit roll. Fail: gain an Enemy.

effects.detail: Deception/Persuade 8+ for Ally + Benefit or Enemy

events.description: You discover a world, artifact, or species that is of great scientific value.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: You serve as the courier for an important message from the Imperium.
events.effectDescription: Either gain one level of Diplomat or DM+4 to your next advancement roll.

effects.detail: Diplomat 1 or DM+4 to next advancement

events.description: You make a truly remarkable discovery, one that changes the course of your field.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: Your ship is damaged and you have to hitch a ride back. Gain one of Mechanic 1, Survival 1, Engineer 1 or Electronics 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain Mechanic 1, Survival 1, Engineer 1 or Electronics 1.

effects.detail: Gain Mechanic 1, Survival 1, Engineer 1 or Electronics 1

mishaps.description: Your scout ship is one of the ones that never come back.
You are psychologically damaged by your time in the scouts. Reduce INT or SOC by 1.
Your ship encounters an anomaly that causes damage. Gain a Contact.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
